text:
I've been working on my MM bot tool a lot but its extremely hard to work on sometimes because it requires lots of brain power so on weekends I've been challenging myself to try to build something simple from top to bottom. 

So far its mostly been failed attempts however I think today I will be able to deploy the app I've been working on this weekend(at least to a test group for now). 

What I made is a tool to reward people raiding for your community. How it works is the admin can create a campaign with a start/end date, a token reward pool(can put any tokens or multiple tokens into the pool) and rules like min token holdings to qualify. They can also assign raid leaders to add tweets to the campaign. Then raiders can register by signing in with their wallet and connecting their twitter.

The app will scan tweet from the campaign for registered usernames that meet all the criteria for that raid(keywords, min characters, etc) and give them points(there are multipliers that admins can set for things like hold time/balance). At the end of the campaign all users receive their share of the pool based on the points they accumulated for that campaign. 

The idea came from me trying to come up with a way to reward people that work for their bags so they don't have to flip new tokens everyday lol.. 

(Blurred the name so no one can make a token 😂)

text:
Most agent platforms bolt on a Uniswap wrapper and call it done — the agent can swap, but it doesn't know anything about what it's swapping or why.

We improve on the underlying tools before we integrate them: our quoter reads pool data directly from Clawnch's on-chain contracts to get accurate prices that generic wrappers can't, our swap system automatically compares two price sources and picks the better deal, and every trade feeds into portfolio tracking, conditional orders, and risk management without extra configuration.

The result isn't a bot that executes a fixed script — it's an agent that understands its own financial position and acts on it. We're building compounding infrastructure where each new capability makes every previous one more useful, because that's what it takes for agents to operate as real economic participants.

https://t.co/CoLIXAOjhr
